description: This file defines a HintsWrapper class and related functions for wrapping and tracing functions with context hints in PyTorch, involving proxy modes, functionalization, and autograd support.

classes.name: HintsWrapper
classes.description: A class for wrapping functions with context hints, extending HigherOrderOperator.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Wraps a function with provided args, kwargs, and hints, performing validation.

methods.name: hints_wrapper_dense
methods.description: Implementation of hints_wrapper for the CompositeExplicitAutograd dispatch key.

methods.name: hints_wrapper_functionalize
methods.description: Functionalizes the hints_wrapper, handling tensor unwrapping and rewrapping.

methods.name: trace_hints_wrapper
methods.description: Traces the hints_wrapper function, creating a proxy and tracking tensor trees.

methods.name: inner
methods.description: Dispatches to trace_hints_wrapper or hints_wrapper based on proxy_mode.enable_tracing.
